required_content.problem: A living technical book must absorb sources, structural changes, evidence movement, corrections, derivatives, and releases without losing canonical identity or failed history.
required_content.core_mechanism: An Evidence-Preserving Publication Transaction freezes scope and authority, separates provenance lanes, binds claim dependencies, regenerates projections, runs surface-specific gates, and preserves correction and successor custody.
required_content.worked_trace: A withdrawn source propagates through its claim, chapter, proof note, appendix, synopsis, transcript, video packet, public page, and citation while historical release identity remains immutable.
required_content.failure_boundary: Source counts, theorem builds, validators, renders, polished prose, local artifacts, deployment, and publication remain non-substitutable and cannot establish chapter truth or approval.
required_content.evidence_state: The core remains Design rationale at argument support; the strongest local bundle has 3 slices, 12 cases, 10 lifecycle states, 6 effects, 3 rollbacks, 20 boundary injections, 11 rejecting mutations, and an 11-surface sealed epoch.
required_content.non_claims: The visual claims no source-interpretation proof, whole-book truth, editorial approval, accessibility approval, transfer, external publication, release, or support promotion.
required_content.handoff: Open Research Agenda and Bibliography Plan next turns unresolved sources, artifacts, proofs, experiments, reproductions, and rejections into one durable backlog.
